name: 范書愷
objective:
針對學生之學習研究心得報告，集體討論，以訓練學生研究之能力。

Regarding students' reports on journal paper reading, conduct group discussions to train students' research abilities and research spectrum."
schedule:
每週次以學生研讀學術論文進行專題報告為主。

Each week focuses primarily on students reading academic papers and giving topical presentations.
scorePolicy:
1. 口頭報告
2. 書面報告
3. 出席率與上課互動

Oral presentation
Written report
Attendance rate and class participation
materials:
學校期刊資料庫

University Subscribed Journal Database
consultation: Consulting time can be reserved in advance via email: morrisfan@ntut.edu.tw
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
